mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO minute_quote (stock_code, trade_time, price, volume, amount, avg_price) VALUES
(#{item.code}, #{item.tradeTime}, #{item.price}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amount}, #{item.avgPrice})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price = VALUES(price), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount), avg_price = VALUES(avg_price)

INSERT INTO daily_quote (stock_code, date, open, high, low, close, pre_close, volume, amount) VALUES
(#{item.code}, #{item.date}, #{item.open}, #{item.high}, #{item.low}, #{item.close}, #{item.preClose}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amount})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open = VALUES(open), high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), pre_close = VALUES(pre_close), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount)
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code AS code, trade_time, price, volume, amount, avg_price FROM minute_quote WHERE trade_time >= #{date} AND trade_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY stock_code, trade_time

SELECT d.id, d.stock_code AS code, d.date, d.open, d.high, d.low, d.close, d.pre_close, d.volume, d.amount FROM daily_quote d INNER JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(date) AS max_date FROM daily_quote GROUP BY stock_code ) t ON d.stock_code = t.stock_code AND d.date = t.max_date
SELECT id, stock_code AS code, date, open, high, low, close, pre_close, volume, amount FROM daily_quote WHERE stock_code = #{code} ORDER BY date ASC
